Your hydrogen was a bad idea.''"<br />"''It got us here.|Korsin Bentado and Edell Vrai discussing the drawbacks of the Tribe's airship technology|<ref name="pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>}}
'''Airships''' were the primary means of transport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Exocron]], and were used from military and economic purposes. Several classes were constructed and operated by private individuals and the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. Airships were also built by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in order to cross the large ocean between [[Keshtah Minor]] and [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. These airships played an important role in the Lost Tribe's [[Invasion of Alanciar|annexation]] of Alanciar. Following the "unification" of the two continents under Lost Tribe rule, they were phased out in favor of Alanciari sailing ships due to their combustible nature.
